The '''''Phoenix''''' was a [[GX1 short hauler/Legends|GX1 short hauler]] used by the Galactic Republic during an attempt to negotiate with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatists]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
[[File:PhoenixEscapePod-SWE.png|thumb|left|200px|The hyperdrive-enabled escape pod]]
The ''Phoenix'' was used by members of a diplomatic envoy to the neutral planet of [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]], where the talks took place. It was guarded by [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]] during the negotiations.<ref name="AFIN" />

[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Lux Bonteri/Legends|Lux Bonteri]] used the ship to escape Mandalore after Lux disrupted the peace talks and [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] ordered him to be executed. Bonteri later hijacked the vessel and steered it to [[Carlac/Legends|Carlac]], where he met up with a group of [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] warriors led by [[Pre Vizsla/Legends|Pre Vizsla]], believing they would help him kill the Count.<ref name="AFIN" />

After Ahsoka and Lux attempted to stop the Mandalorians from burning a local [[Ming Po/Legends|Ming Po]] [[Ming Po town|town]], they fled in this ship and Bonteri stole a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]-equipped [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pod]] to continue his quest to kill [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]].<ref name="AFIN" />
